offline_target.name: target_scheduled_visit_30d
eligible_if: no known scheduled_visit with response_event_at <= score_time
all features are observable at or before score_time

statuses.POSITIVE: known unique scheduled_visit event inside the interval
statuses.NEGATIVE: full 30-day maturation and no known/ambiguous event that could be inside the interval
statuses.AMBIGUOUS_UNKNOWN_EVENT_TIME: scheduled_visit exists but event time is unknown and could intersect the target interval
statuses.INELIGIBLE_PRIOR_SCHEDULED_VISIT: known scheduled_visit already occurred at or before score_time
statuses.RIGHT_CENSORED: less than 30 complete days are observable after score_time

online_primary_outcome.name: lead_scheduled_visit_30d_from_assignment
online_primary_outcome.denominator: all eligible randomized leads (intention-to-treat), including scoring/fallback failures
assignment_rules: assignment persisted in UTC before experimental scoring/routing

production_data_quality.duplicate_events: deduplicate using backend event id; deterministic key must be frozen if no id exists

prohibited_inputs: current/future broker response of the scored inquiry

online_estimand.name: ATE_30d_ITT_risk_difference
online_estimand.formula: P(Y=1 | assigned Treatment) - P(Y=1 | assigned Control)
